column2: Ever pure are the cows that nourish all; ever sinless are the gods.
Come with the forest; the cows follow the path with their udders.
Dwelling near the honeyed feast, may we thrive; we meditate on wealth, O Indra, for you.
The Maruts of fair hymns sing the hymn; the famed youth, Indra, makes the response.
Sing a song to your Indra, the best Vritra-slayer, the sage, whom he delights in.
Agni has been noticed, the wise bearer of oblations, like one with a splendid chariot.
O Agni, be our nearest, our savior, kind and our protector.
Like Bhaga, wondrous Agni bestows treasure on the mighty.
Let the chant be before all, whether in the front, or here and now.
Dawn, best sister, turns her path round in her good birth.
May we complete these worlds happily, Indra and all the gods.
Like paths spreading out, may your gifts, Indra, go forth in all directions.
By this may we win the strength set by the gods, and rejoice with good heroes for a hundred winters.
With strength may Mitra and Varuna swell Ida; Indra, give us abundant food.
Indra rules over all.

In the Trikadrukas the mighty one of great strength, satisfied, drank the soma pressed with Vishnu, as he wished; he rejoiced to perform the great deed; the true god-drop, the true Indra, joins the great, wide god.

This thousand-fold guide is the sight of the seers, a thought, light of the rite; the firm one stirred the dawns together, blameless and of one mind in the cow's dwelling, full of spirit, the cow's gift.

Come, Indra, to us from afar, like a lord of the good to the sacrifices, like a king, lord of the good. We call you, giving, at the pressings, as sons call a father for winning strength, the greatest for winning strength.
I call that Indra, the bounteous, fierce, ever holding fame, unrepelled, many-sided; greatest, to be worshipped with songs, may he, the thunderbolt-bearer, make all our paths good for wealth.

Let there be hearing before; with thought I set Agni in front; now we choose that divine host, we choose Indra and Vayu. When the performers bind the nave for the new Vivasvat, then thoughts truly approach, as thoughts go toward the gods.

Let the prayers of ours born from the mountain go forth to the great Vishnu with the Maruts; to the mighty, the worshipful, the good eater, the strong one, delighting in sacrifice, the shaker of the rites, the powerful.

Purified by this golden light, he passes over all hatreds with his fellow-yoked, like the sun with his companions; the stream shines on the back, the purified red-bay one; when he goes around all forms with the singers, the seven-mouthed singers.

I praise that god Savitar in the two forms, the wise, truth-impelling, the dear thought in the treasury of jewels; whose high light shone in his impulse; the golden-handed, skilful one measured out heaven by his grace.

I regard Agni as the priest, the giver, the son of the Vasu, born of strength, Jatavedas, the sage; the god who with his high-reaching grace goes well-sacrificing to the gods, after the shining of the ghee, of the bright-flamed one, the poured butter.

That manly deed of yours, O Indra, the ancient first, wrought in heaven, is to be proclaimed; who by the god's strength released the vital waters; you overcame the godless by might; the hundred-powered found strength and food.
Your high birth of the drink is placed in heaven and on earth; fierce shelter, great fame.
Flow, Soma, with the sweetest, most exhilarating stream; pressed for Indra to drink.
Flow as a bull with the stream, joyful for the Maruts too, bearing all with strength.
By the choicest exhilaration of yours, flow with the drink, guardian of the gods, slayer of the evil-speaking.
Three speeches arise; the cows low; the bay-colored one goes roaring.
O drop, flow for Indra with the Maruts, most honeyed, to sit in the womb of the hymn.
The stalk was pressed for exhilaration, the skilful, mountain-born, in the waters; like a falcon it sat in its nest.
Flow, accomplisher of skill, for the gods to drink, bay-colored one; the exhilaration for the Maruts and Vayu.
Flowing, the mountain-dwelling Soma has streamed through the filter; in joys you are all-sustaining.
The seer, beloved of heaven, set among the two grandchildren, goes with shouts, wise in purpose.
The somas, exhilaration-dropping, have gone forth for our fame, bounteous, pressed at the ritual.
The sage-somas, the waves, carry along the waters, like buffaloes through woods.
Flow, drop, the bull pressed; make us famous among the people; drive away all enemies.
You are a bull by your radiance; we call you, shining one, O flowing, seer of heaven.
The drop has been cleansed, the conscious, dear thought of the seers; it sends forth like a charioteer his horse.
The strong somas have been released for cattle and horses, bright, swift for heroism.
Flow, god, for life; may your exhilaration go to Indra; mount Vayu by your law.
The purifying one begot the wondrous thunder from heaven — the great light of Vaishvanara.
The sounding drops flow around with a mighty song, for exhilaration, with the stream of honey.
The seer has flowed around, set on the wave of the river, bearing the much-desired singer.
The gods have approached the drop just born, wave-crossing, adorned with cow-milk.
The all-seeing, purifying, has overcome all enemies; the sages adorn the wise one with devout thoughts.
The pressed drop, entering the vessel, flowing toward all glories, is placed for Indra.
It has been released like a chariot-horse, pressed in the filter and the vessels; the racer has stepped into the course.
When the radiant ones, like cattle, have gone swiftly, smiting the black skin.
Smiting enemies, you flow, O Soma, the wise, exhilarating; drive away the godless man.
Flow with this stream by which you made the sun shine, urging on the human waters.
Flow, you who helped Indra to slay Vritra who covered the great waters.
With this feast flow around, O drop, you who in the joys slew ninety-nine.
Flow around, giving heaven-dwelling wealth, to Bharadvaja with our drink; flow, sounding, into the filter.
The bay-colored bull has roared, great, like Mitra beautiful to see; he shines together with the sun.
Today we choose your skill, the happiness-giving carrier, the best protector, much desired.
O Adhvaryu, bring the soma pressed by stones to the filter; purify it for Indra's drinking.
The joyful one crosses over, the stream of the pressed drink runs; the joyful one crosses over and runs.
Flow to us, Soma, a thousandfold wealth, with heroic strength; grant us fame.
After them the ancient Ayus have stepped to a newer place; they brought forth the sun for light.
Flow, Soma, most splendid, roaring toward the vessels, sitting in the womb of wombs.
Soma, you are a bull, splendid; god, a bull, of bull-like works; as a bull you hold the laws.
Flow for strength with the stream, adorned by the wise; O drop, come with light to the cows.
Flow, Soma, with the joyful stream, a bull, god-loving, through the woolen sieves, desiring us.
By this good deed, Soma, though great, you have grown; urged on, you act as a bull.
This all-seeing one has been placed, flowing, he is aware; urging the great kindred waters.
Go forth, O drop, to us for great things, bearing the wave; you move toward the gods.
Smiting enemies he flows, Soma, smiting the niggardly, going to the portion of Indra.
Purified, Soma, with the stream you move clad in waters; giver of jewels, you sit in the seat of truth, the golden god fountain.
Pour around the pressed soma, which is the highest oblation; the manly who is among the waters has pressed soma with stones.
Come, Soma, sounding with the stones across the sheep's wool; like a man entering a city, the bay-colored enters the vessels, dwelling in the woods.
Go forth, Soma, for the gods' feast; like a river you swell with the flood; with the milk of the stalk, joyful, wakeful, honey-dripping, toward the treasury.
Soma is being pressed by the pressers upon the sheep's wool; like a mare it goes with the green stream, it goes with the joyful stream.
In your friendship, Soma, O drop, I rejoice day by day; the many go about me, O brown one; pass those obstacles here.
Cleansed with good hands, you drive the speech into the sea; you flow, purifying, toward the tawny, abundant, much-desired wealth.
The somas flow of the Ayus toward the joyful exhilaration, on the summit of the ocean; the wise, joyful, exhilaration-dropping.
Purified, Soma, wakeful, dear, around the woolen strainers; you became the sage, O best of Angirases; sprinkle our sacrifice with honey.
The exhilarating soma flows for Indra with the Maruts; thousand-streamed, it passes over the wool; the Ayus cleanse it.
Flow, best winner of strength, toward all desirable things; you, the ocean, in the first rite, joyful for the gods, Soma.
The purifying ones have been released across the filter with the stream; the joyful, Indra-possessing, driven ones toward wisdom and offerings.
Run forth, sit around the vessel, purified by men, flow toward strength; they cleanse you like a swift horse and lead you with reins to the grass.
Speaking a poem like Ushanas, the god proclaims the births of the gods; the great-vowed, pure-kinned purifier, like a boar, goes forward, roaring.
The carrier sends forth three speeches, the thought of truth, the wisdom of prayer; the cows go asking the lord of cattle; the prayers go to Soma, longing.
Purified by the golden sending forth, the god mingled his essence with the gods; the pressed one goes around the filter roaring, like the priest around a house rich in cattle.
Soma flows, begetter of thoughts, begetter of heaven, begetter of earth; begetter of Agni, begetter of the Sun, begetter of Indra, and begetter of Vishnu.
The voices have desired the three-backed bull, giver of vigor, the one sounding; clothed in woods like Varuna in rivers, the jewel-giver distributes desirable things.
The ocean has stepped out in the first rite, begetting offspring, the guardian of the world; the bull upon the high woolen peak, great Soma, sounding stone, has grown.
The bay one cries aloud as he is released, sitting in the belly of the wood, being purified; held by men, he makes the cow-skin clean; thence the wise beget thought by their own powers.
This honeyed soma of yours, Indra, the bull, flows around the filter of the bull; giver of a thousand, giver of a hundred, bountiful, the strong one has stood on the ever-spread grass.
Flow, Soma, honeyed, truth-keeping, clad in waters, on the woolen peak; descend into the buckets rich in ghee, most exhilarating, joyful, drunk by Indra.
The army-leader hero goes in front of the chariots, desiring cattle; his army rejoices; making good for friends the calls of Indra, Soma takes the vigorous garments.
Your honeyed streams have been released when, purified, you pass over the woolen sieve; flowing, you flow, abode of the cows, begetting the sun and quickening it with hymns.
Sing, we honor the gods, urge on Soma for great wealth; may the sweet one flow across the woolen sieve; may the divine drop sit in the vessel.
Urged on, the begetter of heaven and earth, like a chariot seeking strength, he has run; going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, taking all wealth in his hands.
When he fashioned the speech of the longing mind, the law of the eldest in the front of the sky-dwelling bull; then the cows, desiring the best, approached the beloved lord, the drop in the vessel.
Together the ten sisters, the thoughts of the wise, the pressing hands, cleansed the bull; the bay one ran around, born of the sun; like a swift horse he reached the trough.
When in this bright one the thoughts, like racing mares, contend like clans for the sun; choosing the waters he flows, as a fence-wanting poet, a hymn for increasing cattle.
The racing drop flows, flooding cattle; Soma urging strength toward Indra for exhilaration; he slays demons, repels the foe all around, making room, king of the dwelling.
Flow with this, flow with these riches, run into the lake, O drop of Indra; whose swiftness like the wind, even the much-wise sets in the man.
Soma, the great, the mighty, did that great deed when, the embryo of the waters, he chose the gods; the flowing one placed strength in Indra and the drop made light in the sun.
The eloquent has been released like a chariot-horse in the race; with devout thought, first among thoughts of mind; the ten sisters on the woolen peak cleanse the carrier in the homes.
Like waves of waters hastening, the thoughts go forth toward Soma; bowing, they come near and together, and enter the longing one, longing.
For the pressed, exhilarating drink, you who go before — drive away the dog of long tongue, O friends.
This Pushan, wealth, Bhaga, Soma, flows purifying; lord of all abundance, he has lit up both worlds.
The pressed somas, most honeyed, exhilarating for Indra, have flowed with the filter; may your exhilarations go to the gods.
The somas flow, drops, best finders of a way for us; friendly, sounding, blameless, thoughtful, finders of heaven.
Flow to us, O drop, wealth, the best strength-winner, a hundredfold desired, a thousand-nourishing, of great splendor, overcoming.
They cleanse toward Indra's dear, desirable one, the guileless; like a calf born in the first age, the mothers lick it.
They stretch their bows of manly power for the bold hero; the bright ones go forth for the purifying of the lord, before the sages, enhancing the great.
